- Next step: schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive/demo where our solutions engineer (Dev) will walk through architecture, latency/cost tradeoffs, and a short configuration walk-through.
- Attendees: please confirm who from your side should join (e.g., engineering, security, procurement).
- Proposed times (PT): Wed 3/4 10:00–11:00, Thu 3/5 11:00–12:00, or Fri 3/6 09:00–10:00. If none of these work, send a couple alternatives and I'll align calendars.

I'm attaching a short demo agenda (high-level) so you can share with your team. Once you confirm a time and attendee list I'll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and the technical deck.
